title: The Newcomes: Memoirs of a Most Respectable Family
sourceTitle: The Newcomes: Memoirs of a Most Respectable Family
author: William Makepeace Thackeray
description: "The Newcomes: Memoirs of a Most Respectable Family" by William Makepeace Thackeray is a novel published in 1854-1855.
longDescription: The story follows Colonel Thomas Newcome, a virtuous man, and his son Clive, who aspires to become a painter despite family disapproval.

authorInfo.bio: William Makepeace Thackeray was an English novelist and illustrator. He is known for his satirical works, particularly his 1847–1848 novel Vanity Fair, a panoramic portrait of British society, and the 1844 novel The Luck of Barry Lyndon, which was adapted for a 1975 film by Stanley Kubrick.
